review:
Star Trek: The Next Generation is an officially licensed BGaming slot with cascading reels and the Enterprise crew, including Deanna Troi and Data. Filling the power meter triggers The Next Generation Respin Bonus simulation.

A Warp Speed Wheel with three levels adds instant prizes, and there are four free spins 'missions' to choose from. The respin bonus can be bought, with three random symbols filling the meter and one to five respins awarded, as can free spins where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 96.46% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 197 spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
